description: §14.8.9 S456 — a BOUND `Response.json` — a call no Response recognizer names; caught by the handle() exit sink (the value handle() returns is a client egress), through the fail-closed unknown-callee rule. The protected column leaves the server outside its row: E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED at base 2dd6d35d9 (S456, g-handle-globalthis-response-ships-protected-columns): compiled at exit 0 and the emitted server answered HTTP 200 with the passwordHash in the body. §14.8.9 closed-world precondition: an author-constructed Response (§40) that carries a protected-origin column SHALL fail closed; Sinks: every argument of an author-built Response, Response.json, Response.redirect; the S447 r8 rule that a value read from the global heap resolves to its named path whether spelled or aliased.
